name: BIO-RAD LABORATORIES, INC.
sector: Healthcare / Life science tools & clinical diagnostics
moat_justification: Moderate/narrow moat 5/10: real switching costs from validated diagnostic systems and a consumables pull-through model, plus ddPCR leadership, but no growth for four years, falling gross and operating margins, and a low measured ROIC proxy (0.4% in FY2025, 2.8-3.7% in FY2020-24, flattered denominator aside) do not support a wide-moat score.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 2.9%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 11.61 vs 3-yr median 8.06 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
one_liner: Solid diagnostics franchise, moat 5/10, but flat revenue and a $352.82 price leave it far short of 15% - weighted IRR 5.34%, IV@15% $81.28 vs $352.82; it would need to fall to about $81 to clear 15%.
moat_for: Razor-and-blade model: installed instruments pull through high-margin consumables, quality controls and reagents
Leading positions in quality controls, blood typing and diabetes testing in Clinical Diagnostics - validated systems create switching costs
Digital PCR (ddPCR) leadership, strengthened by the Stilla acquisition - Q2 2026 ddPCR revenue up ~6% and instrument sales up >20%
Gross margin has held around 52-56% through a cycle despite volume softness
Recurring consumables/services mix and a long installed-base history in hospital and reference labs
moat_against: Revenue flat for four years (FY2022 $2,802M to FY2025 $2,583M); 2026 guidance -3% to +0.5% currency-neutral
Academic/government research funding softness hits Life Science; China weakness persists
Gross margin slipped from 56.5% (FY2020) to 51.9% (FY2025) and operating margin collapsed to 1.8% in FY2025
ROIC proxy only 0.4%-3.7% over the last six years (denominator inflated by the Sartorius stake, but core returns are still thin)
Process chromatography is lumpy and concentrated; restructuring ($90M one-time, $30-35M targeted savings) is unproven
